(Currently Amended) Claim 281: A tool comprising: a lamination of at least two layers; a first adhesive layer; a second adhesive layer, each adhesive layer being configured to bond to a respective layer, with the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer located on opposite sides of a medial section; an additional adhesive layer, wherein the first adhesive layer and the second adhesive layer are aligned with the additional adhesive layer in registration with the medial section. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 290: The tool of claim 281, wherein the medial section comprises a metal.

(Currently Amended) Claim 291: The tool of claim 290, wherein the medial section includes a central opening.

(Currently Amended) Claim 293: The tool of claim 281, further comprising a weld ring at least partially interposed between the perimeter of the first and second layers. 

(Currently Amended) Claim 294: The tool of claim 293, wherein the weld ring is continuous.
